purpose: A one-line command or agent prompt with a copy button, set in a large `InputGroup` under hero or section copy ("npm create azion", "Ask your agent to …"). With `shell` a `$` prompt leads the line. From the design sample's site `SectionCommand`.
useWhen: The one command that starts a product, beside or instead of a call to action.
A prompt to paste into an AI agent (`shell` off).
avoidWhen: For several lines or output — use `CodeBlock` or `CliTerminal`.
bestPractices: One line that works when pasted as is.
Place it in a hero or section-title actions slot.
